entities.summary: The Yangwang U9 is a battery electric super-coupe manufactured by BYD Auto under its luxury car brand Yangwang. The U9 is the second vehicle from the Yangwang brand after the U8 off-road SUV, and was formally introduced on Auto Shanghai in April 2023. As of September 2025, its "Xtreme" variant is unofficially the fastest production car in the world with a top speed of 496 kilometres per hour (308 mph).
